chapter: Listening to the Troy Floyd records
title: Reed and brass line-up of the Floyd band
summary: Albert describes three saxes with Troy on lead alto, Scott Bagby's clarinet, John Humphrey on drums, two trumpets and trombone, and puzzles over whether Herschel was in the band.
